bullets.text: STL's Competitive Edge - **STL** leads UK's connectivity growth with fiber and data center solutions, anticipating hyperscaler demand.
UK Telcos Unite Against Scams - Major UK **telcos** launch a new **Telecommunications Fraud Charter** to combat scam calls.
Zoom's UK Data Centre Plans - **Zoom** will open a UK data center in 2026 to meet local data residency requirements.
Jamf's AI Forensics Tool - **Jamf** launches AI Analysis for iOS forensics to enhance mobile threat detection.
Verizon and AWS Fiber Expansion - **Verizon** partners with **AWS** to build fiber routes for AI's bandwidth demands.
BT's Revenue Decline - **BT** reports a 3% revenue decline, cutting 5,000 jobs amid competitive pressures.
Digital Catapult's Open RAN Testing - **Digital Catapult** admits six vendors to advance Open RAN trials in the UK.
Telefónica's Growth Strategy - **Telefónica** unveils a strategic plan focusing on AI-driven innovation and operational efficiency.
Changing Video Consumption Trends - Over half of UK TV content is now consumed via apps, creating data challenges.
AWS Fastnet Cable Announcement - **AWS** plans a new transatlantic cable to enhance cloud and AI traffic capacity.
